16421125.verdict: 半場 0-0 猜中了，但比賽走勢和預想不同：控球少的 Sevilla 靠高強度逼搶壓住了 Real Betis（xG 1.11 對 0.14，射門 13 對 3），犯規和黃牌都比預期多得多。
points: 半場比分 0-0 預測正確，但上半場進球預期 0.4/0.5 低估了 Sevilla、高估了 Real Betis：Sevilla 射門 13 次、xG 1.11，只是射正 2 次，把握機會很差；Real Betis 控球 58% 卻只有 3 次射門、xG 0.14，進攻幾乎沒有威脅，可能和3天後踢歐冠而輪換有關。
角球 1 對 2，比預測的 2.0/2.2 少；Sevilla 多是遠射和中路射門，沒有打出多少邊路傳中，所以角球少。
犯規 11 對 4（預測 6.3/5.4），Sevilla 用大量犯規打斷對手推進；黃牌已經 2 對 2，共 4 張，遠超上半場預測的 0.8/0.6，Derby 的火爆程度提前爆發，全場黃牌 6.5 張的盤口已經很接近。
16421125.headline: 下半場剩 45 分鐘，Sevilla 機會更多但把握差，Real Betis 要改善進攻才有機會；低比分、平局機會最高，黃牌和犯規仍會偏多。
16421125.changes: 勝平負從 31/30/39 改為 33/41/26：Sevilla 上半場明顯佔優，而 Real Betis 進攻幾乎沒有威脅，只剩 45 分鐘、0-0 之下平局機率大升，客勝機率下降。最可能比分改為 0-0。全場角球從 4.3/4.6 降到 3.5/4.0（上半場只有 3 個）。犯規 Sevilla 從 13.5 升到 18.0，Real Betis 從 11.5 降到 10.0。黃牌 Sevilla 3.4→3.5，Real Betis 2.6→3.3，因為上半場已各 2 張，不過已吃黃牌的 Agoumé 和 Salas 下半場會收斂。大 2.5 球只剩 13%。
16421125.verdict_en: The 0-0 half-time call was right, but not the way we expected: Sevilla had less of the ball yet pressed hard and dominated Real Betis (xG 1.11 vs 0.14, shots 13 vs 3), with far more fouls and cards than predicted.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time score was correct, but the 1H goal expectation of 0.4/0.5 underrated Sevilla and overrated Real Betis: Sevilla had 13 shots and 1.11 xG but only 2 on target, so their finishing was poor; Real Betis had 58% possession but only 3 shots and 0.14 xG, barely a threat, possibly because of rotation ahead of their European game in 3 days.
Corners were 1 vs 2, below the predicted 2.0/2.2; Sevilla mostly shot from distance and through the middle rather than attacking down the wings, so few corners came.

Fouls were 11 vs 4 (predicted 6.3/5.4), with Sevilla fouling a lot to stop Betis moving forward; yellow cards are already 2-2, 4 in total, far above the predicted 0.8/0.6 for the first half. The derby heated up early, and the 6.5 full-match card line is already close.
16421125.headline_en: With 45 minutes left, Sevilla are creating more but finishing poorly, and Real Betis need to improve their attack to have a chance. Expect a low score with a draw the most likely result, and fouls and cards should stay high.
16421125.changes_en: 1X2 moved from 31/30/39 to 33/41/26: Sevilla clearly had the better first half and Real Betis created almost nothing, so with 0-0 and only 45 minutes left the draw is much more likely and the away win less likely. The most likely score is now 0-0. Full-match corners cut from 4.3/4.6 to 3.5/4.0 (only 3 in the first half). Fouls: Sevilla up from 13.5 to 18.0, Real Betis down from 11.5 to 10.0. Cards: Sevilla 3.4→3.5, Real Betis 2.6→3.3, since each side already has 2, though the booked Agoumé and Salas should be more careful in the second half. Over 2.5 goals is now only 13%.

rules.zh: 總進球：全場進球預期比基準下調約 0.3 球（原本是 0.5）。以下情況不下調：熱門一方勝率不低於 65%；主隊場均失球不少於 2 球，而對手是進攻型球隊。天氣（風、雨）不能單獨作為下調理由。預期總進球低於 2.3 時，前三個比分選項必須包含 0-0 或 1-0。
rules.en: Total goals: trim the baseline by about 0.3 (was 0.5). Do not trim when the favourite's win probability is 65% or higher, or when the home side concedes 2+ per game and faces an attacking opponent. Weather (wind or rain) alone is not a reason to trim. When expected goals are below 2.3, the top three scorelines must include 0-0 or 1-0.
rules.evidence: 偏差累積從 11 場的 +0.91 降到 21 場的 +0.40，第13輪平均約 -0.16，說明下調 0.5 球已經過頭。被低估的比賽：Barcelona 3-2 Villarreal、Racing Club 3-2 Real Sociedad（雙方 xG 合計 6.17）、Getafe 0-3 Atlético Madrid、Alavés 3-1 Deportivo。低比分場次仍然存在：Sevilla 0-0 Alavés、Celta 0-0 Levante、Osasuna 1-0 Málaga。

rules.zh: 平局和低位防守：勝平負三項接近（最高一項低於 45%）時，平局至少給 30%。主隊預期控球佔優，但面對深度防守的對手，同時主隊缺少主力前鋒或終結能力差時，主勝要比市場低 5–10 個百分點，多出來的機率分給平局和客隊小勝（0-1）。射門多不等於 xG 高。
rules.en: Draws and low blocks: when the 1X2 is close (top outcome below 45%), give the draw at least 30%. When a possession-favoured home side faces a deep block and is missing its main strikers or finishes poorly, set the home win 5-10 points below the market and move that probability to the draw and a narrow away win (0-1). Many shots do not mean high xG.
rules.evidence: 5 場：Athletic Club 0-1 Espanyol（射門 16 對 6，缺 Guruzeta 和 Sannadi）、Rayo Vallecano 0-1 Valencia（射門 21 對 11，xG 只有 0.64）、Levante 1-1 Elche（射門 18 對 4，xG 0.81）、Sevilla 0-0 Alavés（第12輪）、Celta 0-0 Levante（第12輪，xG 3.04 對 0.22）。

rules.zh: 上半場：上半場進球預期只下調約 0.2（原本是 0.4）。只有在預期總進球低於 2.5、熱門勝率低於 60% 時，半場首選比分才用 0-0。強弱懸殊的比賽，半場首選用熱門一方 1-0 領先，也要考慮弱隊開場偷襲進球的情境。
rules.en: First half: trim 1H goals by only about 0.2 (was 0.4). Use 0-0 as the top HT pick only when expected total goals are below 2.5 and the favourite is under 60%. In mismatches, make the favourite 1-0 up the top HT pick, and allow for an early smash-and-grab by the underdog.
rules.evidence: 第12輪有 7/10 場半場 0-0，第13輪只有 3/10 場（Athletic Club、Sevilla、Levante）。上半場進球偏差累積從 +0.57 降到 +0.20。上半場就分出高下的例子：Getafe 0-2、Barcelona 0-2、Racing Club 早段 2-0、Osasuna 1-0、Real Madrid 0-1。

rules.zh: 半場更新：0-0 時平局可以提高 8–12 個百分點。比分相同或落後、但 xG 和射門大幅領先（例如 xG 差距 0.6 以上）的一方，勝率應該維持甚至提高，不要降超過 10 個百分點，也不要因此提高平局。弱隊半場領先時，它的勝率不要調到 50% 以上。
rules.en: HT update: at 0-0 the draw may rise 8-12 points. A side that is level or behind but well ahead on xG and shots (xG gap of 0.6 or more) should keep or gain win probability: cut it by no more than 10 points, and do not raise the draw because of it. An underdog leading at HT should not be raised above 50%.
rules.evidence: 調得過頭的例子：Real Madrid 半場 0-1 時被降到 32%，最後 2-1 獲勝；Alavés 半場 xG 0.68 對 0.02，我們卻把平局提高到 42%，最後 3-1 獲勝；第12輪的 Elche 0-2 Real Betis 和 Real Sociedad 1-0 Rayo Vallecano 也是過度反應；Málaga 領先時被調到 63%，最後 1-2 輸球。

rules.zh: 角球要偏向佔優的一方：預期控球不低於 58%，或勝率不低於 60% 的一方，角球比本季平均加 1.5–2.5 個；被壓制的一方減 1–2 個（最少可以只有 1–2 個）。Real Madrid 和 Barcelona 不再例外，不自動下調。全場角球的總數不要因為對手打防守而減少。
rules.en: Skew corners to the dominant side: a team with expected possession of 58% or more, or a win probability of 60% or more, gets +1.5 to 2.5 corners over its season average; the pressed side gets 1-2 fewer (it can be as low as 1-2). Real Madrid and Barcelona are no longer exceptions and are not cut automatically. Do not lower the match total just because the opponent defends deep.
rules.evidence: 全場角球偏差 -0.72，連續 3 輪為負（stable）。第13輪佔優一方的角球：Barcelona 10 對 0、Athletic Club 9 對 2、Rayo Vallecano 8、Real Madrid 8、Alavés 8 對 2、Sevilla 7 對 2。第12輪：Espanyol 9、Villarreal 9。第12輪 Barcelona 只有 2 個、Real Madrid 只有 5 個，第13輪已被推翻。

rules.zh: 角球和比分走勢：被看好的一方一旦落後，下半場角球要多加 2–3 個；弱隊領先後收縮防守，它下半場的角球接近 0。中下游主隊對強隊、雙方都以邊路傳中為主時，全場角球基準上調 2–3 個。
rules.en: Corners follow the game state: once the favourite falls behind, add 2-3 second-half corners for it; an underdog that leads and sits deep gets close to 0 corners after the break. Lower-half home side vs a strong team, both relying on wing play and crosses: raise the match corner baseline by 2-3.
rules.evidence: Racing Club 3-2 Real Sociedad：上半場已有 13 個角球，全場 21 個（預測 10.8）；Barcelona 落後 0-2 時全場角球 10 對 0；Osasuna 1-0 Málaga 下半場兩隊都是 0 個角球；Elche-Betis 全場 17 個（預測 9.4，第12輪）。

rules.zh: 犯規：全場犯規總數維持基準，不再下調。Derby 或身體對抗激烈的比賽，總數加 5–8 次。控球不低於 60% 的強隊，犯規減 40–50%。預期會領先後退守的一方犯規要加；很早落後的被壓制一方，犯規反而會減少。
rules.en: Fouls: keep the match total at baseline and stop trimming it. Derbies or very physical matches: add 5-8 to the total. A strong side with 60%+ possession: cut its fouls by 40-50%. Add fouls for a side likely to lead and then sit deep; a pressed side that falls behind early tends to foul less.
rules.evidence: AI 犯規 MAE 5.9，比基準的 5.79 還差。Sevilla-Real Betis 35 次（預測 25），Alavés-Deportivo 35 次（預測 24.5）。強隊犯規少：Real Madrid 4 次（預測 9.5），第12輪 Real Madrid 6 次、Villarreal 6 次。領先後退守的一方犯規多：Villarreal 19、Valencia 17、Osasuna 19（第12輪）。早早落後的 Getafe 只有 11 次（預測 14）。

rules.zh: 黃牌分配看比分走勢，不看名氣：賽前兩隊黃牌接近平分，最多按 55/45 稍微偏向較弱的一方。控球佔優、大概率輕鬆領先的強隊，黃牌不超過 1.5 張。追分的一方和死守一球領先的一方，下半場黃牌都會增加。
rules.en: Allocate yellows by likely game state, not reputation: split them close to even before kick-off, tilting at most 55/45 toward the weaker side. A dominant strong side likely to cruise gets at most 1.5. Both the chasing side and a side defending a one-goal lead pile up second-half yellows.
rules.evidence: 追分一方黃牌多：Athletic Club 3 對 1、Levante 4 對 1。死守領先一方黃牌多：Osasuna 4 對 0 加一張紅牌、Villarreal 6 張加一張紅牌。被看好吃牌的客隊反而少：Valencia 1 張（預測 2.7）、Getafe 2 張（預測 2.9）。Real Madrid 只有 1 張。原本「落後一方佔 60–75% 黃牌」的守則被推翻。

rules.zh: 黃牌時段和總數：上半場黃牌比基準減約 0.2，全場黃牌加約 0.3。預期比分膠著（平局或一球差），或者是護級戰、derby 時，下半場再加 0.5–1 張；Derby 的黃牌預測放在盤口上方。75 分鐘後兩黃變一紅的風險很高，紅牌或點球不要給 0。
rules.en: Card timing and totals: trim 1H yellows by about 0.2 and add about 0.3 to the full-match total. For tight games (draw or one-goal margin), relegation battles or derbies, add another 0.5-1 in the second half; put derby cards above the bookmaker line. The risk of a second-yellow red after 75' is high, so never price a red card or penalty at zero.
rules.evidence: 全場黃牌偏差 -0.37，上半場黃牌偏差 +0.16。Sevilla-Real Betis 9 張（盤口 6.5），Alavés-Deportivo 8 張（預測 4.1）。紅牌：Navarro、Catena、Djené 都是第13輪第 90 分鐘前後兩黃變一紅；第12輪還有 Aznou（64'）和 Gayà。

rules.zh: 裁判：裁判本季的平均黃牌數要和聯賽平均 50/50 混合後才使用。兩支強隊對碰時，嚴格裁判的加成再減半。球隊的粗野名聲權重要低於裁判的實際數據。
rules.en: Referees: blend the referee's season yellow average 50/50 with the league average before using it. When two strong teams meet, halve the strict-referee uplift. A team's rough reputation weighs less than the referee's actual numbers.
rules.evidence: Atlético-Barcelona（嚴格的 Alberola Rojas）：4 張黃牌，預測 4.8。Villarreal-Getafe（寬鬆的 Muniz）：Getafe 只有 2 張，預測 3.4。第13輪 Getafe 吃牌也比名氣預期少（2 張，預測 2.9）。

playbook.summary_zh: 總進球和上半場進球的下調幅度減半（第13輪顯示上一版調得過頭），半場 0-0 改為有條件才用；角球規則改成偏向佔優的一方，取消 Real Madrid 和 Barcelona 的例外，另加一條按比分走勢調角球；犯規總數不再下調，黃牌分配從「落後一方多吃牌」改為看比分走勢（追分的一方和死守領先的一方都會多吃牌）；新增低位防守下熱門主隊的主勝要比市場低的守則。
playbook.summary_en: Halved the goal and first-half goal trims (round 13 showed the previous version overcorrected) and made 0-0 the HT pick only under conditions. Corners now skew to the dominant side with no Real Madrid/Barcelona exception, plus a new game-state corner rule. Foul totals are no longer trimmed, and yellow allocation now follows the likely game state (both chasing sides and sides defending a lead pick up cards) instead of 'trailing side gets most'. Added a rule to price possession-favoured home sides below the market against deep blocks.
